Prompt injection is a technique in which an attacker crafts an input that causes a language model to follow the attacker’s instructions unintentionally. In the context of Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, prompt injection is used to manipulate the model’s query or generation process—often by “probing” the hidden context that the model has retrieved—so that the model regurgitates or reveals information from its internal context or behaves in a way that benefits the attacker【Source 1】.
